title: Script File
content: File Extension: .psc, .pas, .pex, .ppj, .log Files: Source: A .psc file contains papyrus source code. Assembly: A .pas file contains papyrus assembly. Executable: A .pex file is executed by the game. Project: A .ppj file is used with the papyrus compiler. Log: A .log file is used to write Papyrus runtime information to disk for debugging purposes. Tooling: - Creation Kit - Text Editors - Papyrus Compiler - Papyrus Assembler - Papyrus Profile Analyzer - Papyrus Stack Dump Analyzer - There are community software projects that provided tooling for working with scripts.
